This is a case series of 5 children with cryptococcal meningitis, not a randomized controlled trial.
This study examines toxicity of amphotericin B induction therapy, not comparing early vs delayed ART initiation timing.
This is a systematic review and meta-analysis of IRIS incidence, not a primary randomized controlled trial.
This is a letter to the editor discussing methodological concerns about another study, not a primary RCT.
This is a methodological article about GRADE system, not a clinical trial.
This is a prospective observational study of CM-IRIS incidence, not a randomized controlled trial comparing ART timing.
This is a cohort study from Latin America examining outcomes, not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a methodological article about GRADE guidelines, not a clinical trial.
This is a letter/commentary discussing ART timing, not a primary randomized controlled trial.
This article proposes clinical case definitions for cryptococcal IRIS, not a randomized controlled trial.
This is an observational study of an early ART program for various OIs including TB and CM, not a randomized controlled trial specifically comparing early vs delayed ART for cryptococcal meningitis.
This is a randomized controlled trial comparing earlier ART initiation (1-2 weeks) vs deferred ART (5 weeks) in HIV-infected adults with cryptococcal meningitis. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a global burden estimation study, not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a review article about antifungal medicine access, not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a letter expressing concerns about another randomized study, not a primary RCT itself.
This is an observational study of amphotericin B toxicities, not a randomized controlled trial comparing ART timing.
This is a descriptive longitudinal observational study, not a randomized controlled trial.

This is a randomized trial comparing early vs deferred ART for various OIs (63% PCP, 12% CM, 12% bacterial), not specifically focused on cryptococcal meningitis. The CM subgroup is too small to provide meaningful evidence for this review.
This is an EBM review/commentary about the Bouleware study (study 13), not a primary randomized controlled trial.
This appears to be an observational analysis of mortality rates, not a randomized controlled trial. The abstract does not mention randomization.
This is a letter/commentary discussing ART timing strategies, not a primary randomized controlled trial.
This is a randomized treatment-strategy trial comparing ART initiation within 7 days vs after 28 days in HIV-infected adults with cryptococcal meningitis. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a randomized trial about ART initiation in asymptomatic HIV infection with CD4>500, not about cryptococcal meningitis.
This is an observational study of CM relapse after fluconazole monotherapy, not a randomized controlled trial comparing ART timing.
This is an observational study of IRIS in cryptococcal disease, not a randomized controlled trial comparing ART timing.
This is a review article about cryptococcal meningitis epidemiology and therapy, not a randomized controlled trial.
This is a prospective multicenter observational study of cryptococcal IRIS, not a randomized controlled trial comparing ART timing.

This is a randomized clinical trial comparing early ART (within 72h) vs delayed ART (after 10 weeks) in HIV-positive individuals with cryptococcal meningitis in sub-Saharan Africa. Meets all selection criteria.
This is a review article about cryptococcal meningitis epidemiology, immunology, diagnosis and therapy, not a randomized controlled trial.
